criteria_results.text: Exact-owner projectless sessions carry authoritative rhythm profile state on every mobile-gateway read surface; unbound rows attach nothing.
criteria_results.notes: 5/5 server suite incl. unbound-row case; device-confirmed after desktop relaunch.

criteria_results.text: Unknown or unbound session state never persists fallback preferences or overrides the engine session configuration.
criteria_results.notes: Unbound-state case added after live DB inspection showed agent_kind backfill pollutes opencodeAgentId; fresh corruption observed mid-smoke and closed.

criteria_results.text: Session opened with a selected profile shows and executes that profile on device.
criteria_results.notes: Device probe chain: draftProfile=secretary catalog=0 (bug) -> capabilities-follow-scope fix -> catalog=22, user-confirmed success. Final root cause was the profile catalog being cleared on scope switches with only the Chat-tab bootstrap refetching it.

criteria_results.text: Recently opened chats switch instantly; list does not flash empty or reload unprompted; no error overlays.
criteria_results.notes: Round 1 device pass FAILED (6s reopens, list churn, 404 overlays); round 2 fixed cross-scope cache destruction, discovery-sweep re-runs, and stale refresh timers. open-from-cache HIT probes confirmed instant serves.

process_issues.description: Server-side fixes were handed to device smoke while the desktop api_server process still ran pre-fix code (started hours earlier); the first retest verdict blamed the fixes. The desktop must be relaunched via tools/dev/launch_desktop_current.sh after ANY apps/api_server change before device validation.
process_issues.detected_by: ps lstart of the 4001 listener vs fix commit time.

process_issues.description: Four distinct client defects (scope-flip cache destruction, discovery sweep re-runs, capability catalog never refetched on the detail route, stale refresh timers) were invisible to jest, fake-server, Playwright web, and the live sandbox; only on-device probes with hit/miss reasons localized them.
process_issues.detected_by: Temporary [i1287] console probes over Metro during live user testing.

observed_chain: orchestrator-diagnosis (six haiku research lanes via Workflow)

issues.description: TodoWrite checklists not expanded; the user's handoff prompt and live iteration drove the sequence.

suggested_follow_up: Device-behavior classes (scope-driven cache lifecycles, catalog refetch coverage, timer scope-safety) need an on-device or scope-flip-simulating test tier; every web-tier gate passed while four device defects shipped. Also: relaunch the desktop stack as a mandatory step whenever apps/api_server changes precede device smoke.
